scripts.jupiter:db:create: docker run --name gloogle-postgres -it -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=gloogle -e POSTGRES_USER=gloogle -d -p 5432:5432 postgres
scripts.jupiter:db:init: yarn jupiter:db:create && sleep 5 && PGPASSWORD=gloogle psql -h localhost -U gloogle < db/seeds.sql
scripts.jupiter:db:drop: docker stop gloogle-postgres && docker rm gloogle-postgres
